title: T3S-01 job-table layout with the row keys + trCA of ct02s-r2ca-tables-p (the part of t3s01-tables-p that t219_dumpv4 reads)

origin.translates: the trCA content of datasets/ngnnguynchn/flag2027-t3s01-tables-p (FLAG_167 T3S-01, 5 fold runs + kaggle/sat_push.sh 167g; staging folders empty, exact notebooks lost) restricted to what CLEANTUNE-01/run.py merge_t3s + FUSENET-01/run.py report (FUSENET_MODE=dumpv4) read

inputs.use: tables/ct01r2_fold1..5.parquet: row keys (fold, data, protocol, y, fi, vi) + trCA

variant.lora_c1: not_used (tables of the F1s' family; no LoRA C1 input)

post_checks: when the frozen datasets/ngnnguynchn/flag2027-t3s01-tables-p is under FF_DATA (02_intermediate/_wiring/flag2027-t3s01-tables-p) or FF_T3S01_FROZEN, the code asserts that the row keys and trCA of every farl table are identical to it (max |diff| 0.0, as WP-F measured on 18/11)
dev_usage: none (SAFE-04 pair tables of the train persons; the tables carry no dev row)
notes: Consumer: t219_dumpv4 mounts the export at the original mount path datasets/ngnnguynchn/flag2027-t3s01-tables-p, so its verbatim code (gather cell: rglob ct01r2?*_fold[1-5].parquet, faces farl / clip / b3s / c5s) is unchanged.

Not identical to the frozen dataset: the 24 trT3S_<face>_<voice> branch columns (sim, r293, ecapa, cat4, wsv, rdn) are absent. No stage of this repository can make them (FLAG_167 notebooks lost); they are not read by the dumpv4 path. t184_report (evidence) keeps the frozen dataset (resolve: saved_only).
sigma: U = F1s|oof + R|oof uses trCA only from these tables, so the sigma of dp_sigma is unchanged when trCA is identical (checked by the post check when the frozen copy is present).
